	public static void MakeDungeon_GenerateNextEntranceHall_Precalculated(DungeonData data, UnifiedRandom genRand, double dist, Vector2D entrancePos, ref int amountPassed, ref Vector2D currentPos)
	{

		int num = genRand.Next(10, 30);
		if ((double)num > dist - (double)amountPassed)
		{
			num = Math.Max(1, (int)dist - amountPassed);
		}
		Vector2D val = Vector2D.Lerp(currentPos, entrancePos, (double)amountPassed / dist);
		DungeonHall dungeonHall = MakeDungeon_GetHall(new LegacyEntranceDungeonHallSettings
		{
			HallType = DungeonHallType.LegacyEntrance,
			StyleData = data.genVars.dungeonStyle,
			RandomSeed = WorldGen.genRand.Next(),
			OverrideSteps = num,
			UsePrecalculatedEntrance = true
		});
		dungeonHall.CalculateHall(data, currentPos, val);
		dungeonHall.GenerateHall(data);
		amountPassed -= num;
		currentPos = val;
		if (amountPassed <= 0)
		{
			data.createdDungeonEntranceOnSurface = true;
		}
	}

171	// DungeonBounds（DungeonBounds.cs）：Left/Right 钳 [10,w-10]、Top/Bottom 钳 [10,h-10]；
172	// CalculateHitbox 保证 R>L、B>T；Contains=Rectangle.Contains 半开区间。
173	class DBnd {
174	  L = 10; R = 10; T = 10; B = 10;
175	  has = false;
176	  constructor(public w: number, public h: number) {}
177	  private cx(v: number): number { return Math.max(10, Math.min(this.w - 10, v)); }
178	  private cy(v: number): number { return Math.max(10, Math.min(this.h - 10, v)); }
179	  set(l: number, t: number, r: number, b: number): void {
180	    this.L = this.cx(l); this.R = this.cx(r); this.T = this.cy(t); this.B = this.cy(b);
181	    this.calc();
182	  }
183	  calc(): void {
184	    if (this.R <= this.L) this.R = this.L + 1;
185	    if (this.B <= this.T) this.B = this.T + 1;
186	    this.has = true;
187	  }
188	  upd(x: number, y: number): void;
189	  upd(minX: number, minY: number, maxX: number, maxY: number): void;
190	  upd(a: number, b: number, c?: number, d?: number): void {
191	    if (c === undefined || d === undefined) {
192	      if (a < this.L) this.L = this.cx(a);
193	      if (a > this.R) this.R = this.cx(a);
194	      if (b < this.T) this.T = this.cy(b);
195	      if (b > this.B) this.B = this.cy(b);
196	    } else {
197	      if (a < this.L) this.L = this.cx(a);
198	      if (c > this.R) this.R = this.cx(c);
199	      if (b < this.T) this.T = this.cy(b);
200	      if (d > this.B) this.B = this.cy(d);
201	    }
202	    this.has = true;
203	  }
204	  topSet(t: number): void { this.T = this.cy(t); this.has = true; }
205	  inflate(a: number): void { this.set(this.L - a, this.T - a, this.R + a, this.B + a); }
206	  contains(x: number, y: number): boolean {
207	    return this.has && x >= this.L && x < this.R && y >= this.T && y < this.B;
208	  }
209	  containsF(x: number, y: number, fluff: number): boolean {
210	    if (fluff === 0) return this.contains(x, y);
211	    return this.has && x >= this.L - fluff && x < this.R + fluff && y >= this.T - fluff && y < this.B + fluff;
212	  }
213	}

215	interface DRoom {
216	  seed: number; x: number; y: number; start: boolean; generated: boolean;
217	  inner: DBnd; outer: DBnd; ex: number; ey: number; strength: number;
218	}

223	}

228	/** #32 Dungeon pass（1456 1:1，与 caves-oracle.cs 同构）。snap 回调用于逐段检查点。 */
229	export function runDungeonPass(
230	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, snap: SnapFn = () => {},
231	): void {
232	  // ★MakeDungeon 头 SetCrackedBrickSolidity(false)（DungeonCrawler.cs:344）——裂纹砖族
233	  //   481/482/483 自本 pass 起恒非实心（还原点 SmoothWorld 头 cs:16510 在 Beaches 之后，
234	  //   不在本段覆盖范围；oracle 同构内联 SOLID.Remove 于 caves-oracle.cs）。CaveWallsPass
235	  //   同款 pass 内接线；WorldGen.ts 管线处的同参调用为幂等重复，保留为时间线存档。
236	  //   ★dungeonI 转写债根因（2026-08-16）：此前仅 dgSolid 打了 481-483 排除补丁，
237	  //   dgLights 的 canHitLocal/placeChand/灯笼上格门仍读静态 TILE_DEFS.solid(=true)，
238	  //   裂纹砖对把开关视线(CanHit)整段拦死 → 开关/灯放置集两侧分叉（同型种子
239	  //   1511931452 绿=数据未踩中，9293480 踩中）。消费端一律走 genSolidType。
240	  flipGenSolid([481, 482, 483], false);
241	  const { w, h } = st;
242	  const ws = gs.worldSurface, rock = gs.rockLevel;
243	  const dgUR = (seed: number): UnifiedRandom => new UnifiedRandom(seed);
244	  // 掷骰适配：ri(a,b)=Next(a,b+1)；rn(n)=Next(n)；rd()=NextDouble()；raw()=Next()
245	  // （dgMainRolls=主流掷骰计数器——仅 __dgLayoutTrace 插桩消费，常态零开销）
246	  let dgMainRolls = 0;
247	  const ri = (a: number, b: number): number => { dgMainRolls++; return rng.int(a, b); };
248	  const rn = (n: number): number => { dgMainRolls++; return rng.nextInt(n); };
249	  const rd = (): number => { dgMainRolls++; return rng.next(); };
250	  const raw = (): number => { dgMainRolls++; return rng.vanilla.next(); };
251	  const theme = gs.dungeonTheme >= 0 ? gs.dungeonTheme : ri(0, 2);
252	  const brick = theme === 0 ? BLUE : theme === 1 ? GREEN : PINK;
253	  const wall = theme === 0 ? 7 : theme === 1 ? 8 : 9;
254	  const crack = CRACKED_FOR_BRICK[brick] ?? brick;
255	  const wallVariants: number[] = wall === 8 ? [8, 98, 99] : wall === 9 ? [9, 96, 97] : [7, 94, 95];
256	  // outerPotentialDungeonBounds（CreatePotentialDungeonBounds，DungeonUtils.cs:2058）
257	  const potTp = (ws + 10.0) / h, potBt = ((h - 200) - 10.0) / h;
258	  const potL = gs.dungeonSide > 0 ? Math.trunc(w * 0.525) : Math.trunc(w * 0.05);
259	  const potR = gs.dungeonSide > 0 ? w - Math.trunc(w * 0.05) : Math.trunc(w * 0.45);
260	  const potT = Math.max(10, Math.min(h - 10, Math.trunc(h * potTp)));
261	  const potB = Math.max(10, Math.min(h - 10, Math.trunc(h * potBt)));
262	  const potContains = (x: number, y: number): boolean =>
263	    x >= Math.max(10, Math.min(w - 10, potL)) && x < Math.max(10, Math.min(w - 10, potR)) && y >= potT && y < potB;
264	  // ★入口三掷已随每 pass 重播改造（2026-08-16）归位 **Dunes pass 头**（cs:11542
265	  //   SetupDungeonGenVarVariables 尾段——主题掷后紧跟）：掷①② Next(3) 与 RandomSeed
266	  //   Next() 原版在 Dunes 消耗，此处只取 Dunes 落盘的 entSeed（兜底自掷仅限绕过
267	  //   Dunes 直调本 pass 的诊断路径，流位与 oracle 不同构）。
268	  const entSeed = gs.dungeonEntSeed ?? raw(); // preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.RandomSeed
269	  const shelf = [ri(9, 12), 0, 0];    // SetupDungeonDataVariables（cs:243-254）
270	  do { shelf[1] = ri(9, 12); } while (shelf[1] === shelf[0]);
271	  shelf[2] = ri(9, 12);
272	  while (shelf[2] === shelf[0] || shelf[2] === shelf[1]) shelf[2] = ri(9, 12);
273	  const lantern = [rn(7), 0, 0];      // cs:255-266
274	  do { lantern[1] = rn(7); } while (lantern[1] === lantern[0]);
275	  lantern[2] = rn(7);
276	  while (lantern[2] === lantern[0] || lantern[2] === lantern[1]) lantern[2] = rn(7);
277	  const bannerStyles = [10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15];
278	  const skewed = rn(4) === 0;         // cs:274 useSkewedDungeonEntranceHalls
279	  const doorStyle = theme === 0 ? 16 : theme === 1 ? 17 : 18;  // Item 1411-1413 placeStyle
280	  const platformStyle = theme === 0 ? 6 : theme === 1 ? 8 : 7; // Item 1384-1386 placeStyle(蓝6/绿8/粉7)
281	  // —— 状态（DungeonData/GenVars）——
282	  const rooms: DRoom[] = [];
283	  const halls: DHall[] = [];
284	  const doorData: DDoor[] = [];
285	  const platData: DPlat[] = [];
286	  const pits: DBnd[] = [];
287	  const bounds = new DBnd(w, h);
288	  const entBounds = new DBnd(w, h);
289	  let entExists = false;
290	  let entOnSurface = false;
291	  let lastHallX = 0, lastHallY = 0;
292	  let pitFlood = true;
293	  let lootStyle = 0;
294	  let posX = 0, posY = 0, topX = 0;
295	  let dungeonX = 0, dungeonY = 0;
296	  let shadowKey = false, ramRune = false;
297	  // —— 深度锚点（cs:14828-14870）——
298	  const x0 = gs.dungeonLocation;
299	  let y0 = Math.trunc((ws + rock) / 2) + ri(-200, 199);
300	  {
301	    const cap = Math.trunc((ws + rock) / 2) + 200;
302	    let solid = false;
303	    for (let k = 0; k < 10; k++) if (dgSolid(x0, y0 + k)) { solid = true; break; }
304	    if (!solid) { while (y0 < cap && !dgSolid(x0, y0 + 10)) y0++; }
305	    if (solid) {
306	      let n4 = 0;
307	      while (dgSolid(x0, y0 - n4)) { n4++; if (n4 === 60) break; }
308	      if (n4 < 60) y0 += 60 - n4;
309	    }
310	  }
311	  // —— MakeDungeon（cs:327-505）——
312	  const s1x = ri(25, 29) + 0.0, s1y = ri(20, 24) + 0.0;
313	  const s2x = ri(35, 49) + 0.0, s2y = ri(10, 14) + 0.0;
314	  let num = Math.trunc(w / 60); num += rn(Math.trunc(num / 3));          // cs:353-355 num += Next(0, num/3)
315	
316	  // ================= 基础谓词（DungeonUtils / WorldGen 门禁同构）=================
317	  function dgSolid(x: number, y: number): boolean {
318	    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
319	    const i = st.idx(x, y);
320	    if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
321	    const sheet = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
322	    if (!genSolidType(st.type[i]) || DG_SOLID_TOP.has(sheet)) return false;
323	    if (sheet === 481 || sheet === 482 || sheet === 483) return false;   // SetCrackedBrickSolidity(false)（DC:344；pass 头 flipGenSolid 后冗余双保险）
324	    return true;
325	  }
326	
327	  // 锚腿判定（TileObject.cs:376-442 AnchorBottom 链，chest 21/467；sheet 空间）：
328	  // ①SolidTile：tileSolid&&!solidTop&&!noAttach&&!anchorInvalid（FlattenAnchors=false 须
329	  //   blockType()==0——pass 内无半砖/坡，恒真）；②SolidWithTop|Table：平台/solidTop/桌
330	  //   （生成期 G/C 箱腿实测全砖，平台 properTopFrame 未建模备案）；EmptyTile 不在锚类型。
331	  function chestLegOK(lx: number, ly: number): boolean {
332	    const i = st.idx(lx, ly);
333	    if (!st.flags[i]) return false;                                   // nactive()=false
334	    const sheet = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
335	    const internal = st.type[i];
336	    if (genSolidType(internal) && !DG_SOLID_TOP.has(sheet) && !DG_NO_ATTACH.has(sheet) && !DG_CHEST_ANCH_INVALID.has(sheet)) return true;
337	    if (DG_PLATFORMS.has(sheet)) return !DG_CHEST_ANCH_INVALID.has(sheet);
338	    if (genSolidType(internal) && DG_SOLID_TOP.has(sheet)) return true;
339	    if (DG_TILE_TABLE.has(sheet)) return true;
340	    return false;
341	  }
342	
343	  // GetHighestProtectionTypeFromPoint（DungeonUtils.cs:1704-1724）。
344	  // ★2026-08-13 逐源核实：Legacy 管线（LegacyDungeonLayoutProvider）只调 GenerateRoom/
345	  //   GenerateHall、从不调 CalculateRoom/CalculateHall → LegacyDungeonRoom.calculated 恒 false
346	  //   且 _outerShapeData/_innerShapeData 恒空（LegacyDungeonRoom.cs:252-259 仅 !generating 时
347	  //   填充）→ GetProtectionTypeFromPoint（:56-67）走 `!_outerShapeData.Contains(...)` 恒返
348	  //   ProtectionType.None。即原版 Legacy 地牢对走廊/挖空 **无任何房间保护**（TilesAndWalls
349	  //   分支在 Legacy 房型上不可达——覆写至多返 Walls）。本仓 prot() 返 Walls（外框内）是
350	  //   "同值重刷跳过"级近似：下游三循环仅用它跳过 chWall(chWall 写的就是同一 wall 值)，
351	  //   与原版 None 的最终方块态零差；保持现状不改（按审计要求补内框保护反而会偏离原版）。
352	  function prot(x: number, y: number, list: DRoom[]): number {
353	    let p = 0;
354	    for (const rm of list) {
355	      const q: number = rm.outer.contains(x, y) ? 2 : 0;
356	      if (q === 1) p = p === 2 ? 3 : 1;
357	      else if (q === 2) p = p === 1 ? 3 : 2;
358	      if (p === 3) break;
359	    }
360	    return p;
361	  }
362	  // GetAllRoomsInSpots（:1773）：起/中/终三取样
363	  function roomsInSpots(sx: number, sy: number, ex: number, ey: number, fluff: number): DRoom[] {
364	    const mx = sx + (ex - sx) / 2, my = sy + (ey - sy) / 2;
365	    return rooms.filter((rm) =>
366	      rm.outer.containsF(Math.trunc(sx), Math.trunc(sy), fluff)
367	      || rm.outer.containsF(Math.trunc(mx), Math.trunc(my), fluff)
368	      || rm.outer.containsF(Math.trunc(ex), Math.trunc(ey), fluff));
369	  }
370	  // ★EE 批清坡（2026-08-17）：DungeonUtils.ChangeTileType（DU:1605-1618）= 可选
371	  //   ClearEverything + active(true) + **无条件 Clear(TileDataType.Slope)**（slope=0+
372	  //   halfBrick=false，Tile.cs:815-818）+ type。JS 此前只写 flags/type → 地牢砖压在
373	  //   洞穴坡面格上不清坡 → @52 全图残余 219 格幻影坡主根（Y 批定谳移交）。
374	  //   全部调用点（房/厅/入口城堡/垛口/顶齿/阶梯/坑陷阱/门柱/平台/灯/箱/书架/陷阱族）
375	  //   走此一处收口，同 X 批 TemplePass.setBrick 修法。
376	  function chTile(i: number, t: number, reset: boolean): void {
377	    if (reset) {
378	      st.type[i] = 0; st.wall[i] = 0; st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0; st.flags[i] = 0;
379	      st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;   // ClearEverything（Tile.cs:140-151）含坡位
380	    }
381	    st.flags[i] = 1; st.type[i] = t;
382	    st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;     // Clear(Slope) 无条件（DU:1612；非 reset 也清）
383	  }
384	  function chWall(i: number, wl: number, reset: boolean): void {
385	    if (reset) {
386	      st.type[i] = 0; st.wall[i] = 0; st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0; st.flags[i] = 0;
387	      st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;   // ClearEverything；ChangeWallType 本体不清坡（DU:1620-1631）
388	    }
389	    st.wall[i] = wl;
390	  }
391	  // DungeonHall.CanPlaceTileAt（DungeonHall.cs:161）——普通世界：仅非地牢墙置砖
392	  function canPlaceTileAt(i: number): boolean {
393	    if (isDW(st.wall[i])) {
394	      if (st.flags[i]) {
395	        if (isDT(st.type[i])) return false;
396	        return st.type[i] !== crack;
397	      }
398	      return false;
399	    }
400	    return true;
401	  }
402	  // ================= LegacyDungeonLayoutProvider.LegacyDungeonLayout（:25-98）=================
403	  function dgLayout(steps: number): void {
404	    bounds.set(posX, posY, posX, posY);
405	    // ★LegacyDungeonLayoutProvider.cs:37/:42——起始房之前先耗两颗 settings.RandomSeed
406	    //  (hall-settings 与 room-settings 对象的种子;本仓 settings 复用单流,掷而不用。
407	    //  曾缺失→起始房种子前移 2 颗,全地牢分叉;oracle 对账时揪出)
408	    raw(); raw();
409	    dgRoom({ seed: raw(), x: posX, y: posY, start: true, generated: true, inner: new DBnd(w, h), outer: new DBnd(w, h), ex: 0, ey: 0, strength: 0 });
410	    let roomDelay = 5;
411	    let s = steps;
412	    // 对账插桩(dormant)：__dgLayoutTrace 存在时逐迭代记掷数/门值/roomDelay（离群种子
413	    // dungeonL 微差定位用；零开销常驻，同 __dgHallTrace 惯例）
414	    const LT = (globalThis as { __dgLayoutTrace?: Array<Record<string, number>> }).__dgLayoutTrace;
415	    const ltIt = LT ? LT.length : 0;
416	    let ltRolls0 = 0;
417	    if (LT) ltRolls0 = dgMainRolls;
418	    if (LT) LT.push({ it: -1, rolls: ltRolls0, gate: -1, rd: 5, branch: -1 });
419	    while (s > 0) {
420	      bounds.upd(posX, posY);
421	      s--;
422	      if (roomDelay > 0) roomDelay--;
423	      // ★LegacyDungeonLayoutProvider.cs:61 `(roomDelay == 0) & (Next(3) == 0)` 是
424	      //  非短路 &——roomDelay>0 时也**照耗**一颗 Next(3)(曾 && 短路少耗;oracle
425	      //  同款偏差已在 caves-oracle.cs 同步修正)。TS 禁 bool &,先掷后判语义等价。
426	      //  入口循环(DungeonCrawler.cs:426)才是 && 短路,勿混
427	      const roomRoll = rn(3);
428	      let ltBranch = 0;
429	      if (roomDelay === 0 && roomRoll === 0) {
430	        roomDelay = 5;
431	        ltBranch = 1;
432	        if (rn(2) === 0) {
433	          const sx = posX, sy = posY;
434	          dgHall({ seed: raw(), generated: true, forceX: false, isEntrance: false, bounds: new DBnd(w, h), sx: 0, sy: 0, ex: 0, ey: 0, sdx: 0, sdy: 0, edx: 0, edy: 0 });
435	          if (rn(2) === 0) { ltBranch = 3; dgHall({ seed: raw(), generated: true, forceX: false, isEntrance: false, bounds: new DBnd(w, h), sx: 0, sy: 0, ex: 0, ey: 0, sdx: 0, sdy: 0, edx: 0, edy: 0 }); }
436	          dgRoom({ seed: raw(), x: posX, y: posY, start: false, generated: true, inner: new DBnd(w, h), outer: new DBnd(w, h), ex: 0, ey: 0, strength: 0 });
437	          posX = sx; posY = sy;
438	        } else {
439	          ltBranch = 2;
440	          dgRoom({ seed: raw(), x: posX, y: posY, start: false, generated: true, inner: new DBnd(w, h), outer: new DBnd(w, h), ex: 0, ey: 0, strength: 0 });
441	        }
442	      } else {
443	        dgHall({ seed: raw(), generated: true, forceX: false, isEntrance: false, bounds: new DBnd(w, h), sx: 0, sy: 0, ex: 0, ey: 0, sdx: 0, sdy: 0, edx: 0, edy: 0 });
444	      }
445	      if (LT) LT.push({ it: ltIt + (steps - s) - 1, rolls: dgMainRolls - ltRolls0, gate: roomRoll, rd: roomDelay, branch: ltBranch });
446	    }
447	    dgRoom({ seed: raw(), x: posX, y: posY, start: false, generated: true, inner: new DBnd(w, h), outer: new DBnd(w, h), ex: 0, ey: 0, strength: 0 });
448	  }
449	  // ================= LegacyDungeonRoom.LegacyRoom（:104-304）=================
450	  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
451	  function dgRoom(s: any): void {
452	    const hr = dgUR(s.seed);
453	    const hri = (a: number, b: number): number => hr.nextIntRange(a, b + 1);
454	    const hrn = (n: number): number => hr.nextInt(n);
455	    const hrd = (): number => hr.nextDouble();
456	    const num2 = Math.trunc(15.0) + hri(0, 14);                 // 15 + Next(15)
457	    let vx = hri(-10, 10) * 0.1, vy = hri(-10, 10) * 0.1;
458	    if (vx === 0 && vy === 0) {
459	      if (hrn(2) === 0) vx = hrn(2) !== 0 ? 1 : -1;
460	      else vy = hrn(2) !== 0 ? 1 : -1;
461	    }
462	    let px = s.x + 0.0, py = s.y - num2 / 2.0;
463	    let num4 = Math.trunc(10.0) + hri(0, 9);                    // 10 + Next(10)
464	    const num5 = num2, num6 = 0.5;
465	    const rm: DRoom = { seed: s.seed, x: s.x, y: s.y, start: s.start, generated: true, inner: new DBnd(w, h), outer: new DBnd(w, h), ex: 0, ey: 0, strength: 0 };
466	    rm.inner.set(Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py), Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py));
467	    rm.outer.set(Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py), Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py));
468	    rooms.push(rm);
469	    while (num4 > 0) {
470	      num4--;
471	      const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(w - 1, Math.trunc(px - num2 * 0.800000011920929 - 5.0)));
472	      const x1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(w - 1, Math.trunc(px + num2 * 0.800000011920929 + 5.0)));
473	      const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(h - 1, Math.trunc(py - num2 * 0.800000011920929 - 5.0)));
474	      const y1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(h - 1, Math.trunc(py + num2 * 0.800000011920929 + 5.0)));
475	      bounds.upd(x0, y0, x1 - 1, y1 - 1);
476	      rm.outer.upd(x0, y0, x1 - 1, y1 - 1);
477	      const ix0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(w - 1, Math.trunc(px - num2 * num6)));
478	      const ix1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(w - 1, Math.trunc(px + num2 * num6)));
479	      const iy0 = Math.max(0, Math.min(h - 1, Math.trunc(py - num2 * num6)));
480	      const iy1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(h - 1, Math.trunc(py + num2 * num6)));
481	      rm.inner.upd(ix0, iy0, ix1 - 1, iy1 - 1);
482	      for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
483	        for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
484	          const i = st.idx(x, y);
485	          st.liquid[i] = 0;
486	          if (!isDW(st.wall[i])) chTile(i, brick, true);
487	        }
488	      }
489	      for (let x = x0 + 1; x < x1 - 1; x++) {
490	        for (let y = y0 + 1; y < y1 - 1; y++) chWall(st.idx(x, y), wall, false);
491	      }
492	      for (let x = ix0; x < ix1; x++) {
493	        for (let y = iy0; y < iy1; y++) chWall(st.idx(x, y), wall, true);
494	      }
495	      px += vx; py += vy;
496	      vx = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, vx + hri(-10, 10) * 0.05));
497	      vy = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, vy + hri(-10, 10) * 0.05));
498	    }
499	    rm.ex = px; rm.ey = py; rm.strength = Math.trunc(num5);
500	    // ★2026-08-16 审计：LegacyDungeonRoom **不回写** generatingDungeonPositionX/Y
501	    //   （1456 全 Rooms 目录零赋值，仅 Halls 两处：LegacyDungeonHall.cs:862 /
502	    //   LegacyEntranceDungeonHall.cs:367；1405 DungeonRoom 同样只记 dRoomX 数组）。

728	  // ============ LegacyEntranceDungeonHall.LegacyHall（:23-380，UsePrecalculatedEntrance=false）============
729	  function dgEntHall(seed: number): void {
730	    const hr = dgUR(seed);
731	    const hri = (a: number, b: number): number => hr.nextIntRange(a, b + 1);
732	    const hrn = (n: number): number => hr.nextInt(n);
733	    let px = posX + 0.0, py = posY + 0.0;
734	    const num = hri(5, 8);
735	    // ★2026-08-16 审计：C# 掷序 num4=Next(10,30) 在 :136（startPosition 之后、
736	    //   方向掷段 :148-158 **之前**）——原 JS/oracle 把它挪到了方向掷后，种子流
737	    //   全体错位（strength 吃了方向骰、方向骰吃 steps 骰）。归位原版序。
738	    const steps = hri(10, 29);
739	    let dir = px <= topX ? 1 : -1;
740	    if (px > w - 400) dir = -1;
741	    else if (px < 400) dir = 1;
742	    let vx = dir + 0.0, vy = -1.0;
743	    if (hrn(3) !== 0) vx *= 1 + hri(0, 199) * 0.01;
744	    else if (hrn(3) === 0) vx *= hri(50, 75) * 0.01;
745	    else if (hrn(6) === 0) vy *= 2.0;
746	    if (skewed) {
747	      if (posX < w / 2 && vx < 0 && vx < -0.5) vx = 0.5;
748	      if (posX > w / 2 && vx > 0 && vx > 0.5) vx = -0.5;
749	    } else {
750	      if (posX < w / 2 && vx < -0.5) vx = -0.5;
751	      if (posX > w / 2 && vx > 0.5) vx = 0.5;
752	    }
753	    const num5 = 0.5;
754	    const n6 = 30;
755	    const hb = new DBnd(w, h);
756	    hb.set(Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py), Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py));
757	    const hall: DHall = { seed, generated: true, forceX: false, isEntrance: true, bounds: hb, sx: px, sy: py, ex: 0, ey: 0, sdx: vx, sdy: vy, edx: vx, edy: vy };
758	    halls.push(hall);
759	    const roomsArea = roomsInSpots(px, py, px + vx * steps, py + vy * steps, Math.trunc(steps / 2 + num));
760	    let num4 = steps;
761	    while (num4 > 0) {
762	      num4--;
763	      if (!inW(Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py), n6 + 5)) break;
764	      const x0 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(w - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(px - num - 4.0 - hrn(6))));
765	      const x1 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(w - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(px + num + 4.0 + hrn(6))));
766	      const y0 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(h - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(py - num - 4.0)));
767	      const y1 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(h - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(py + num + 4.0 + hrn(6))));
768	      bounds.upd(x0, y0, x1, y1);
769	      hb.upd(x0, y0, x1, y1);
770	      const n13 = px > w / 2 ? -1 : 1;
771	      const n14 = Math.trunc(px + s1x * 0.6 * n13 + s2x * n13);
772	      const n15 = Math.trunc(s2y * 0.5);
773	      if (py < ws - 5.0) {
774	        const wy = Math.trunc(py - num - 6.0 + n15);
775	        const open = inW(n14, wy, 0) && wallAt(n14, wy) === 0
776	          && inW(n14, wy - 1, 0) && wallAt(n14, wy - 1) === 0
777	          && inW(n14, wy - 2, 0) && wallAt(n14, wy - 2) === 0;
778	        if (open) {
779	          entOnSurface = true;
780	          tileRunner(st, rng, gs, n14, wy, { strength: hri(25, 34), steps: hri(10, 19), type: -1, speedX: 0, speedY: -1 });
781	        }
782	      }
783	      for (let x = x0; x < x1; x++) {
784	        for (let y = y0; y < y1; y++) {
785	          const i = st.idx(x, y);
786	          const p = prot(x, y, roomsArea);
787	          if (p === 3) continue;
788	          const f2 = p !== 1;
789	          st.liquid[i] = 0;
790	          if (f2 && canPlaceTileAt(i)) chTile(i, brick, true);
791	        }
792	      }
793	      for (let x = x0 + 1; x < x1 - 1; x++) {
794	        for (let y = y0 + 1; y < y1 - 1; y++) {
795	          const i = st.idx(x, y);
796	          const p = prot(x, y, roomsArea);
797	          if (p === 3) continue;
798	          let f3 = true;
799	          if (p === 2 && isDW(st.wall[i])) f3 = false;
800	          if (f3) chWall(i, wall, false);
801	        }
802	      }
803	      let n16 = 0;
804	      if (hrn(num) === 0) n16 = hri(1, 2);
805	      const kx0 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(w - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(px - num * num5 - n16)));
806	      const kx1 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(w - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(px + num * num5 + n16)));
807	      const ky0 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(h - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(py - num * num5 - n16)));
808	      const ky1 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(h - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(py + num * num5 + n16)));
809	      for (let x = kx0; x < kx1; x++) {
810	        for (let y = ky0; y < ky1; y++) {
811	          const i = st.idx(x, y);
812	          const p = prot(x, y, roomsArea);
813	          if (p === 3) continue;
814	          let f4 = true;
815	          if (p === 2 && isDW(st.wall[i])) f4 = false;
816	          st.flags[i] = 0;
817	          st.slope[i] = 0; st.half[i] = 0;       // ClearTile()（LEDH:348 内挖——清坡+半砖）
818	          if (f4) chWall(i, wall, false);
819	        }
820	      }
821	      if (entOnSurface) num4 = 0;
822	      px += vx; py += vy;
823	      if (py < ws) vy *= 0.9800000190734863;
824	    }
825	    posX = Math.trunc(px); posY = Math.trunc(py);
826	    hall.ex = px; hall.ey = py;
827	  }

829	  // ============ LegacyDungeonEntrance.LegacyEntrance（Entrances/LegacyDungeonEntrance.cs:31-619）============
830	  function dgEntrance(seed: number, preSeed: number): void {
831	    const hr = dgUR(preSeed);
832	    const hri = (a: number, b: number): number => hr.nextIntRange(a, b + 1);
833	    const hrn = (n: number): number => hr.nextInt(n);
834	    const dgEntProbe = typeof process !== 'undefined' && process.env?.DG_ENT_PROBE != null;   // 诊断钩：入口 rr 掷序对拍
835	    if (dgEntProbe) {
836	      const pv = new UnifiedRandom(preSeed);
837	      const pdraws: number[] = [];
838	      for (let q = 0; q < 12; q++) pdraws.push(pv.next());
839	      console.log(`DGE-PRE preSeed=${preSeed} draws12=${pdraws.join(',')}`);
840	    }
841	    const i = posX, j = posY;
842	    for (let x = i - 60; x < i + 60; x++) {
843	      for (let y = j - 60; y < j + 60; y++) {
844	        if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
845	        const ti = st.idx(x, y);
846	        st.liquid[ti] = 0; st.liquidType[ti] = 0;

1129	  function stairsCanPlace(x: number, y: number): boolean {
1130	    if (y >= potT - 5) return false;                       // outerPotentialBounds.Top-5 门（:1316）

1137	    }

1140	  function dgStairs(i: number, j: number, dir: number, depth: number): void {
1141	    if (!inW(i, j, 20)) return;                            // :1226
1142	    let num = depth, num2 = depth;
1143	    const num3 = dir === 1 ? 1 : -1;
1144	    let num4 = 0;
1145	    for (let k = i; dir === 1 ? k < i + num2 : k > i - num2; k += num3) {
1146	      num4++;
1147	      for (let l = j + num4; l < j + num; l++)

1149	    }
1150	    num2 = num;
1151	    const sdep = num;
1152	    num4 = 0;
1153	    for (let m = i; dir === 1 ? m < i + num2 : m > i - num2; m += num3) {
1154	      num4++;
1155	      for (let n = j + num4; n < j + sdep; n++) {
1156	        if (!inW(m, n, 10) || n >= potT - 5) continue;
1157	        for (let q = 0; q < 4; q++)                        // n..n-3 清液（:1276-1279）

1182	      }

1184	        platData.push({ x, y: num4 + 1, hall: false, hf: 3 }); f3 = true;
1185	      }
1186	      if (f2 && f3) break;
1187	    }
1188	    let f4 = false, f5 = false;
1189	    for (let y = num3; y <= num4; y++) {
1190	      if (!f4 && inW(num - 1, y, 0) && actAt(num - 1, y) === 0) {

1193	      if (!f5 && inW(num2 + 1, y, 0) && actAt(num2 + 1, y) === 0) {

3041	  let num = x1, num2 = y1;
3042	  const num3 = Math.max(1, Math.min(w - 1, x2));
3043	  const num4 = Math.max(1, Math.min(h - 40, y2));
3044	  num = Math.max(1, Math.min(w - 1, num));
3045	  num2 = Math.max(1, Math.min(h - 40, num2));
3046	  const fullBrick = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {
3047	    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
3048	    const k = st.idx(x, y);
3049	    if (!st.flags[k]) return false;
3050	    const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[k]];
3051	    return !!d?.solid && !d.platform && st.slope[k] === 0 && !st.half[k];
3052	  };
3053	  for (;;) {
3054	    if (num === num3 && num2 === num4) return true;
3055	    const dAbs = Math.abs(num - num3), dOrd = Math.abs(num2 - num4);
3056	    if (dAbs > dOrd) {
3057	      num += num >= num3 ? -1 : 1;
3058	      if (fullBrick(num, num2 - 1) && fullBrick(num, num2 + 1)) return false;
3059	    } else {
3060	      num2 += num2 >= num4 ? -1 : 1;
3061	      if (fullBrick(num - 1, num2) && fullBrick(num + 1, num2)) return false;
3062	    }
3063	    // do-while 条件：落点格"非活性 / 非实心 / 平台"才继续步进；实心非平台 → 穿墙阻挡
3064	    const k = st.idx(num, num2);
3065	    const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[k]];
3066	    const passable = !st.flags[k] || !d?.solid || !!d.platform;
3067	    if (!passable) return false;
3068	    if (num < 1 || num >= w - 1 || num2 < 1 || num2 >= h - 40) return false;
3069	  }
3070	}

			DungeonShapes.CircleRoom innerShape2 = new DungeonShapes.CircleRoom(num11, num12);
			DungeonShapes.CircleRoom outerShape2 = new DungeonShapes.CircleRoom(num13, num14);
			dungeonRoomSettings = new GenShapeDungeonRoomSettings
			{
				ShapeType = GenShapeType.Doughnut,
				InnerShape = innerShape2,
				OuterShape = outerShape2,
				BoundingRadius = ((num13 > num14) ? num13 : num14) + 5,
				HallwayPointAdjuster = 5
			};
			break;
		}
		case DungeonRoomType.GenShapeQuadCircle:
		{
			if (num7 != 1f && genRand.Next(3) == 0)
			{
				num = (int)((float)num * 1.5f);
				num2 = (int)((float)num2 * 1.5f);
			}
			int num8 = Math.Max(5, (int)((float)(num + num2) * 0.5f * 0.75f));
			int num9 = num8 + 8;
			int num10 = (int)((float)num8 * 1.5f);
			DungeonShapes.QuadCircleRoom innerShape = new DungeonShapes.QuadCircleRoom(num8, num10);
			DungeonShapes.QuadCircleRoom outerShape = new DungeonShapes.QuadCircleRoom(num9, num10);
			dungeonRoomSettings = new GenShapeDungeonRoomSettings
			{
				ShapeType = GenShapeType.QuadCircle,
				InnerShape = innerShape,

		}
		dungeonRoomSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
		dungeonRoomSettings.RoomType = roomType;
		dungeonRoomSettings.ProgressionStage = progressionStage;
		dungeonRoomSettings.StyleData = style;
		dungeonRoomSettings.OnCurvedLine = curveLine;
		dungeonRoomSettings.Orientation = SnakeOrientation.Unknown;
		dungeonRoomSettings.ControlLine = line;
		return dungeonRoomSettings;
	}

	public static DungeonHallSettings MakeDungeon_GetHallSettings(DungeonHallType hallType, DungeonData data, Vector2 hallStart, Vector2 hallEnd, DungeonGenerationStyleData style)
	{
		UnifiedRandom genRand = WorldGen.genRand;
		DungeonHallSettings dungeonHallSettings = null;
		switch (hallType)
		{
		default:
			dungeonHallSettings = new LegacyDungeonHallSettings();
			break;
		case DungeonHallType.Regular:
			dungeonHallSettings = new RegularDungeonHallSettings();
			break;
		case DungeonHallType.Stairwell:
			dungeonHallSettings = new StairwellDungeonHallSettings
			{
				CrackedBrickChance = 0.0
			};
			break;
		case DungeonHallType.Sine:
		{
			int num = Math.Max(1, (int)((hallStart - hallEnd).Length() / 30f));
			int iterations = ((num <= 1) ? 1 : (1 + genRand.Next(num - 1)));
			float magnitude = 8f + genRand.NextFloat() * 4f;
			dungeonHallSettings = new SineDungeonHallSettings
			{
				CrackedBrickChance = 0.0,
				Magnitude = magnitude,
				Iterations = iterations,
				FlipSine = (genRand.Next(2) == 0)
			};
			break;
		}
		}
		dungeonHallSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
		dungeonHallSettings.HallType = hallType;
		dungeonHallSettings.StyleData = style;
		return dungeonHallSettings;
	}

	public static DungeonEntranceSettings MakeDungeon_GetEntranceSettings(PreGenDungeonEntranceSettings preSettings, DungeonData data)
	{
		DungeonEntranceSettings dungeonEntranceSettings = MakeDungeon_GetEntranceSettings(preSettings.EntranceType, preSettings.StyleData, data);
		dungeonEntranceSettings.RandomSeed = preSettings.RandomSeed;
		return dungeonEntranceSettings;
	}

	public static DungeonEntranceSettings MakeDungeon_GetEntranceSettings(DungeonEntranceType entranceType, DungeonGenerationStyleData styleData, DungeonData data)
	{
		UnifiedRandom genRand = WorldGen.genRand;
		DungeonEntranceSettings dungeonEntranceSettings = null;
		if (data == null)
		{
			PreGenDungeonEntranceSettings preGenDungeonEntranceSettings = new PreGenDungeonEntranceSettings
			{
				EntranceType = entranceType,
				StyleData = styleData
			};
			int num = 0;
			if (WorldGen.SecretSeed.dualDungeons.Enabled)
			{
				num += 30;
			}
			switch (entranceType)
			{
			default:
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.BuriedEntranceYOffset = num;
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.BuriedEntranceSandDugoutYOffset = -num;
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.RoughHeight = 40;
				break;
			case DungeonEntranceType.Dome:
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.PrecalculateEntrancePosition = true;
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.BuriedEntranceYOffset = 20 + num;
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.BuriedEntranceSandDugoutYOffset = -num;
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.RoughHeight = 55;
				break;
			case DungeonEntranceType.Tower:
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.PrecalculateEntrancePosition = true;
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.BuriedEntranceYOffset = 20 + num;
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.BuriedEntranceSandDugoutYOffset = -num;
				preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.RoughHeight = 120;
				break;
			}
			preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
			return preGenDungeonEntranceSettings;
		}
		bool flag = false;
		switch (entranceType)
		{
		default:
			dungeonEntranceSettings = new LegacyDungeonEntranceSettings();
			break;
		case DungeonEntranceType.Dome:
			dungeonEntranceSettings = new DomeDungeonEntranceSettings();
			dungeonEntranceSettings.PrecalculateEntrancePosition = true;
			break;
		case DungeonEntranceType.Tower:
			dungeonEntranceSettings = new TowerDungeonEntranceSettings();
			dungeonEntranceSettings.PrecalculateEntrancePosition = true;
			break;
		}
		dungeonEntranceSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
		dungeonEntranceSettings.EntranceType = entranceType;
		if (!flag)
		{
			dungeonEntranceSettings.StyleData = styleData;
		}
		return dungeonEntranceSettings;
	}

	public static DungeonRoom MakeDungeon_TryRoom(DungeonData data, int i, int j, DungeonRoomSettings roomSettings, bool addToData = true, int fluff = 0, bool noRoomOverlap = true)
	{
		DungeonRoom roomFound = null;
		if (data.IsAnyRoomInSpot(out roomFound, i, j, new DungeonRoomSearchSettings
		{
			Fluff = fluff
		}))
		{
			return null;
		}
		return MakeDungeon_GetRoom(roomSettings, addToData);
	}

	public static DungeonRoom MakeDungeon_GetRoom(DungeonRoomSettings settings, bool addToData = true)
	{
		DungeonRoom dungeonRoom = null;
		switch (settings.RoomType)
		{
		default:
			dungeonRoom = new LegacyDungeonRoom(settings);
			break;
		case DungeonRoomType.Regular:
			dungeonRoom = new RegularDungeonRoom(settings);
			break;
		case DungeonRoomType.Wormlike:
			dungeonRoom = new WormlikeDungeonRoom(settings);
			break;
		case DungeonRoomType.LivingTree:
			dungeonRoom = new LivingTreeDungeonRoom(settings);
			break;
		case DungeonRoomType.BiomeSquare:
			dungeonRoom = new BiomeSquareDungeonRoom(settings);
			break;
		case DungeonRoomType.BiomeRugged:
			dungeonRoom = new BiomeRuggedDungeonRoom(settings);
			break;
		case DungeonRoomType.BiomeStructured:
			dungeonRoom = new BiomeStructuredDungeonRoom(settings);
			break;
		case DungeonRoomType.GenShapeCircle:
		case DungeonRoomType.GenShapeMound:
		case DungeonRoomType.GenShapeHourglass:
		case DungeonRoomType.GenShapeDoughnut:
		case DungeonRoomType.GenShapeQuadCircle:
			dungeonRoom = new GenShapeDungeonRoom(settings);
			break;
		}
		if (addToData && dungeonRoom != null)
		{
			CurrentDungeonData.dungeonRooms.Add(dungeonRoom);
		}
		return dungeonRoom;
	}

	public static LegacyDungeonHall MakeDungeon_GetHall_Legacy(LegacyDungeonHallSettings settings)
	{
		return (LegacyDungeonHall)MakeDungeon_GetHall(settings);
	}

	public static DungeonHall MakeDungeon_GetHall(DungeonHallSettings settings, bool addToData = true)
	{
		DungeonHall dungeonHall = null;
		dungeonHall = settings.HallType switch
		{
			DungeonHallType.LegacyEntrance => new LegacyEntranceDungeonHall(settings), 
			DungeonHallType.Regular => new RegularDungeonHall(settings), 
			DungeonHallType.Stairwell => new StairwellDungeonHall((StairwellDungeonHallSettings)settings), 
			DungeonHallType.Sine => new SineDungeonHall(settings), 
			_ => new LegacyDungeonHall(settings), 
		};
		if (addToData && dungeonHall != null)
		{
			CurrentDungeonData.dungeonHalls.Add(dungeonHall);
		}
		return dungeonHall;
	}

	public static DungeonEntrance MakeDungeon_GetEntrance(DungeonEntranceSettings settings, bool addToData = true)
	{
		DungeonEntrance dungeonEntrance = null;
		dungeonEntrance = settings.EntranceType switch
		{
			DungeonEntranceType.Dome => new DomeDungeonEntrance(settings), 
			DungeonEntranceType.Tower => new TowerDungeonEntrance(settings), 
			_ => new LegacyDungeonEntrance(settings), 
		};
		if (addToData && dungeonEntrance != null)
		{
			CurrentDungeonData.dungeonEntrance = dungeonEntrance;
		}
		return dungeonEntrance;
	}
}

This is the LegacyEntranceDungeonHall. Key differences for the precalc path (UsePrecalculatedEntrance=true):

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Entrances;

public abstract class DungeonEntrance
{
	public DungeonEntranceSettings settings;

	public bool calculated;

	public bool generated;

	public DungeonBounds Bounds = new DungeonBounds();

	public Point OldManSpawn;

	public bool Processed
	{
		get
		{
			if (!calculated)
			{
				return generated;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public DungeonEntrance(DungeonEntranceSettings settings)
	{
		this.settings = settings;
	}

	public abstract void CalculateEntrance(DungeonData data, int x, int y);

	public abstract bool GenerateEntrance(DungeonData data, int x, int y);

	public virtual bool CanGenerateFeatureAt(DungeonData data, IDungeonFeature feature, int x, int y)
	{

		{

		}

	public void DomeEntrance_Door(DungeonData data, int i, int entranceFloor, int outerSize, int innerSize, bool leftDungeonDoor, bool buried)
	{
		int num = (leftDungeonDoor ? (innerSize - 1) : (-outerSize - 2));
		int num2 = (leftDungeonDoor ? (outerSize + 2) : (-innerSize + 1));
		if (buried)
		{
			num += 2 * ((!leftDungeonDoor) ? 1 : 0);
			num2 += 2 * (leftDungeonDoor ? (-1) : 0);
		}
		Point point = new Point(i + (leftDungeonDoor ? (outerSize - 1) : (-outerSize + 1)), entranceFloor);
		Point point2 = new Point(i + (leftDungeonDoor ? (innerSize + 1) : (-innerSize - 1)), entranceFloor);
		for (int j = num; j <= num2; j++)
		{

			{
				int num3 = j + i;
				int num4 = k + entranceFloor;
				Tile tile = Main.tile[num3, num4];
				if (!buried && ((leftDungeonDoor && num3 >= point.X) || (!leftDungeonDoor && num3 <= point.X)))
				{
					tile.wall = 0;
				}
				if (k >= -2 && k <= 0)
				{
					tile.ClearTile();
				}
			}
		}
		WorldGen.PlaceTile(point.X, point.Y, 10, mute: true, forced: true, -1, 13);
		WorldGen.PlaceTile(point2.X, point2.Y, 10, mute: true, forced: true, -1, 13);
	}

	public void DomeEntrance_TreeOnPillar(UnifiedRandom genRand, int pillarX, int pillarY)

87	function hashGhost(st: { type: Uint16Array; flags: Uint8Array; w: number; h: number }): string {
88	  const n = st.w * st.h;

90	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
91	    if (st.flags[i]) continue;
92	    const v = V_ID[st.type[i]];
93	    ghost[i] = v < 0 ? 0x7fff : v;
94	  }
95	  return fnv1a(ghost);   // fnv1a 返回 hex string（注解曾是 number——陈旧签名残留）
96	}

function surfaceMap(st: TileStore, startX: number, width: number): Int16Array {
  const limit = Math.floor(st.h / 2);
  const out = new Int16Array(width);
  for (let i = 0; i < width; i++) {
    const x = startX + i;
    let found = false;
    let y = 0;
    for (let j = 50; j < 50 + limit; j++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x, j) || !st.flags[st.idx(x, j)]) continue;
      const t = st.type[st.idx(x, j)];
      if (t === CLOUD || t === RAIN_CLOUD) { found = false; continue; }
      if (!found) { y = j; found = true; }
    }
    out[i] = found ? y : limit + 50;
  }
  return out;
}

  //   entSeed 落 gs 供 DungeonPass 的 DgEntrance 消费。

  rng.nextIntRange(0, 3);              // 入口类型掷②

      const gold = new Map<string, string>();
      const goldWall = new Map<string, string>();
      for (const line of golden.checkpoints) {
        const [name, typ, act, wal, liq] = line.split(/[| ]+/);
        gold.set(name, `${typ} ${act} ${liq}`);
        goldWall.set(name, wal);
      }
      const res = chainCheckpoints(c.seedText, c.evil);
      const names = [...gold.keys()];
      let firstBad = '';
      let green = 0, red = 0;
      for (const n of names) {
        const ok = res.grids.get(n) === gold.get(n);
        if (ok) green++; else { red++; if (!firstBad) firstBad = n; }
        console.log(`${n.padEnd(20)} ${ok ? '✓' : '✗'} ${res.grids.get(n)} vs ${gold.get(n)}`);
      }
      for (const n of ['desertentrance', 'deserthive', 'desertdone']) {
        const ok = res.walls.get(n) === goldWall.get(n);
        if (ok) green++; else { red++; if (!firstBad) firstBad = `${n}:wall`; }
        console.log(`${`${n}:wall`.padEnd(20)} ${ok ? '✓' : '✗'}`);
      }
      console.log(`== seed ${c.seedText}: green=${green} red=${red} firstBad=${firstBad || '(none)'}`);
    }, 600000);
  }
});

	public void TowerEntrance_Door(DungeonData data, int i, int entranceFloor, int outerSize, int innerSize, bool leftDungeonDoor, bool buried)
	{
		int num = (leftDungeonDoor ? (innerSize - 1) : (-outerSize - 2));
		int num2 = (leftDungeonDoor ? (outerSize + 2) : (-innerSize + 1));
		if (buried)
		{
			num += 2 * ((!leftDungeonDoor) ? 1 : 0);
			num2 += 2 * (leftDungeonDoor ? (-1) : 0);
		}
		Point point = new Point(i + (leftDungeonDoor ? (outerSize - 1) : (-outerSize + 1)), entranceFloor);
		Point point2 = new Point(i + (leftDungeonDoor ? (innerSize + 1) : (-innerSize - 1)), entranceFloor);
		for (int j = num; j <= num2; j++)
		{
			for (int k = -3; k <= 1; k++)
			{
				int num3 = j + i;
				int num4 = k + entranceFloor;

				if (!buried && ((leftDungeonDoor && num3 >= point.X) || (!leftDungeonDoor && num3 <= point.X)))
				{
					tile.wall = 0;
				}
				if (k >= -2 && k <= 0)

					tile.ClearTile();
				}
			}
		}
		WorldGen.PlaceTile(point.X, point.Y, 10, mute: true, forced: true, -1, 13);
		WorldGen.PlaceTile(point2.X, point2.Y, 10, mute: true, forced: true, -1, 13);
	}

	public void TowerEntrance_LineOfFence(int leftX, int rightX, int y)
	{
		if (y <= 10)
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = leftX; i <= rightX; i++)
		{
			if (leftX >= 10 && rightX <= Main.maxTilesX - 10)

				WorldGen.PlaceWall(i, y, 245, mute: true);
			}
		}
	}

	{

	public bool Pillar(DungeonData data, int i, int j, ushort tileType, ushort wallType, bool generating = false)
	{
		_ = WorldGen.genRand;
		DungeonPillarSettings dungeonPillarSettings = (DungeonPillarSettings)settings;
		int width = dungeonPillarSettings.Width;
		int height = dungeonPillarSettings.Height;
		bool crowningOnTop = dungeonPillarSettings.CrowningOnTop;
		bool crowningOnBottom = dungeonPillarSettings.CrowningOnBottom;
		bool crowningStopsAtPillar = dungeonPillarSettings.CrowningStopsAtPillar;
		int num = 3;
		int topY = 0;
		Bounds.SetBounds(i, j, i, j);
		_ = width / 2;
		for (int k = 0; k < width; k++)
		{
			int num2 = i + k - width / 2;
			int topY2 = j;
			int bottomY = j;
			GenerateTileStrip(dungeonPillarSettings, upwards: true, out topY2, out bottomY, num2, j, height, tileType, wallType, smoothTop: false, smoothBottom: false);
			Bounds.UpdateBounds(num2, topY2, num2, bottomY);
			if (crowningOnTop)
			{
				int pillarHeight = (crowningStopsAtPillar ? (num + 1) : 0);
				if (k == 0)
				{
					GenerateTileStrip(dungeonPillarSettings, upwards: true, out topY, out topY, num2 - 1, topY2 + num, pillarHeight, tileType, wallType, smoothTop: false, smoothBottom: true);
				}
				else if (k == width - 1)
				{
					GenerateTileStrip(dungeonPillarSettings, upwards: true, out topY, out topY, num2 + 1, topY2 + num, pillarHeight, tileType, wallType, smoothTop: false, smoothBottom: true);
				}
			}
			if (crowningOnBottom)
			{
				int pillarHeight2 = (crowningStopsAtPillar ? (num + 1) : 0);
				if (k == 0)
				{
					GenerateTileStrip(dungeonPillarSettings, upwards: false, out topY, out topY, num2 - 1, bottomY - num, pillarHeight2, tileType, wallType, smoothTop: true, smoothBottom: false);
				}
				else if (k == width - 1)
				{
					GenerateTileStrip(dungeonPillarSettings, upwards: false, out topY, out topY, num2 + 1, bottomY - num, pillarHeight2, tileType, wallType, smoothTop: true, smoothBottom: false);
				}
			}
		}
		Bounds.CalculateHitbox();
		return true;
	}

using Terraria.DataStructures;
using Terraria.Utilities;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Features;

public class DungeonWindowBasic : DungeonWindow
{
	public DungeonWindowBasic(DungeonFeatureSettings settings)
		: base(settings)
	{
	}

	public override bool GenerateFeature(DungeonData data, int x, int y)
	{
		generated = false;
		DungeonGenerationStyleData style = ((DungeonWindowBasicSettings)settings).Style;
		if (Window(data, x, y, style, generating: true))
		{
			generated = true;
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public bool Window(DungeonData data, int placeX, int placeY, DungeonGenerationStyleData style, bool generating = false)
	{
		UnifiedRandom genRand = WorldGen.genRand;
		DungeonWindowBasicSettings dungeonWindowBasicSettings = (DungeonWindowBasicSettings)settings;
		int width = dungeonWindowBasicSettings.Width;
		int height = dungeonWindowBasicSettings.Height;
		int overrideGlassPaint = dungeonWindowBasicSettings.OverrideGlassPaint;
		ushort wall = (dungeonWindowBasicSettings.Closed ? style.WindowClosedGlassWallType : style.WindowGlassWallType);
		ushort windowEdgeWallType = style.WindowEdgeWallType;
		int num = style.GetWindowPlatformStyle(genRand);
		if (dungeonWindowBasicSettings.OverrideGlassType > 0)
		{
			wall = (ushort)dungeonWindowBasicSettings.OverrideGlassType;
		}
		if (dungeonWindowBasicSettings.OverridePlatformStyle > -1)
		{
			num = dungeonWindowBasicSettings.OverridePlatformStyle;
		}
		Bounds.SetBounds(placeX, placeY, placeX, placeY);
		for (int i = 0; i < width; i++)
		{
			int num2 = placeX + i - width / 2;
			for (int j = 0; j < height; j++)
			{
				if (!Window_ValidWindowSpot(i, j, width, height))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num3 = placeY + j - height / 2;
				if (i == width / 2 || j == height / 2)
				{
					Main.tile[num2, num3].wall = windowEdgeWallType;
				}
				else
				{
					Main.tile[num2, num3].wall = wall;
					if (overrideGlassPaint >= 0)
					{
						Main.tile[num2, num3].wallColor((byte)overrideGlassPaint);
					}
				}
				Bounds.UpdateBounds(num2, num3);
				if (!Window_ValidWindowSpot(i - 1, j, width, height))
				{
					Main.tile[num2 - 1, num3].wall = windowEdgeWallType;
					Bounds.UpdateBounds(num2 - 1, num3);
				}
				if (!Window_ValidWindowSpot(i + 1, j, width, height))
				{
					Main.tile[num2 + 1, num3].wall = windowEdgeWallType;
					Bounds.UpdateBounds(num2 + 1, num3);
				}
				if (!Window_ValidWindowSpot(i, j - 1, width, height))
				{
					Main.tile[num2, num3 - 1].wall = windowEdgeWallType;
					Bounds.UpdateBounds(num2, num3 - 1);
				}
				if (!Window_ValidWindowSpot(i, j + 1, width, height))
				{
					Main.tile[num2, num3 + 1].wall = windowEdgeWallType;
					Bounds.UpdateBounds(num2, num3 + 1);
					if (num > -1)
					{
						Main.tile[num2, num3 + 1].active(active: true);
						Main.tile[num2, num3 + 1].type = 19;
						Main.tile[num2, num3 + 1].Clear(TileDataType.Slope);
						Main.tile[num2, num3 + 1].frameY = (short)(num * 18);
						WorldGen.TileFrame(num2, num3 + 1);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		Bounds.CalculateHitbox();
		return true;
	}

	private bool Window_ValidWindowSpot(int x, int y, int width, int height)
	{
		if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= width || y >= height)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (y == 0 && (x == 0 || x == width - 1))
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}
}

	private bool Skeletron_ValidSkullSpot(int x, int y, int width, int height)
	{
		if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= width || y >= height)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (y == 0 && (x <= 5 || x >= width - 6))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (y == 1 && (x <= 3 || x >= width - 4))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (y == 2 && (x <= 1 || x >= width - 2))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (y == 3 && (x == 0 || x >= width - 1))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if ((x == 0 && y >= height - 2) || (x <= 1 && y == height - 1) || (x == width - 1 && y >= height - 2) || (x >= width - 2 && y == height - 1))
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private bool Skeletron_ValidJawSpot(Tile tile, int glassWallType, int x, int y, int width, int height)
	{
		if (tile.wall == glassWallType)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= width || y >= height)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (y == height - 1 && (x <= 2 || x >= width - 3))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (y == height - 2 && (x <= 1 || x >= width - 2))
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (y == height - 3 && (x == 0 || x == width - 1))
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

function dgTowerEntrance(i: number, j: number, preSeed: number): void {
  const hr = dgUR(preSeed);
  const hrn = (n: number): number => hr.nextInt(n);
  const windowType = hrn(3);            // 0=Regular 1=SkeletronMosaic 2=MoonLord

    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
    const ti = st.idx(x, y);
    st.liquid[ti] = 0; st.liquidType[ti] = 0;
    st.slope[ti] = 0; st.half[ti] = 0;
  }

  // ============ LegacyEntranceDungeonHall.LegacyHall precalc 支（:23-380，UsePrecalculatedEntrance=true）============
  // CalculateHall(currentPos→lerp 目标) 后 GenerateHall 的生成态：方向/步数被
  // OverrideStart/End 覆写（直线、steps=ceil(段距)），strength=Next(5,9) 存活；
  // 无出地表探测/TileRunner/0.98 衰减（!flag 门）；每 10 步记平台候选（hf=5）。
  // 掷序与 Legacy 支逐位同构（strength→steps→方向链→[步进 3×Next(6)+num16]）——
  // 覆写值弃、存活值（strength/Next(6)/num16）位次不变。
  function dgEntHallPrecalc(seed: number, sx0: number, sy0: number, tgx: number, tgy: number): void {
    const hr = dgUR(seed);
    const hri = (a: number, b: number): number => hr.nextIntRange(a, b + 1);
    const hrn = (n: number): number => hr.nextInt(n);
    const num = hri(5, 8);                                  // strength（存活）
    hri(10, 29);                                            // steps 掷（被 OverrideSteps→ceil 覆写，弃值保位）
    if (hrn(3) !== 0) hri(0, 199);                          // 方向掷链（覆写弃值保位）
    else if (hrn(3) === 0) hri(50, 75);
    else if (hrn(6) === 0) { /* vy*=2 无掷 */ }
    // flag 支直线（:157-171）：v=End-Start 归一，steps=ceil(|v|)，num3=dir.X>0?1:-1
    const vx0 = tgx - sx0, vy0 = tgy - sy0;
    const len = Math.sqrt(vx0 * vx0 + vy0 * vy0);
    const vx = len === 0 ? 1 : vx0 / len;                   // SafeNormalize(v, UnitX)
    const vy = len === 0 ? 0 : vy0 / len;
    let steps = Math.ceil(len / 1);
    let px = sx0 + 0.0, py = sy0 + 0.0;
    const num5 = 0.5;
    const n6 = 30;
    const hb = new DBnd(w, h);
    hb.set(Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py), Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py));
    const hall: DHall = { seed, generated: true, forceX: false, isEntrance: true, bounds: hb, sx: px, sy: py, ex: 0, ey: 0, sdx: vx, sdy: vy, edx: vx, edy: vy };
    halls.push(hall);
    const roomsArea = roomsInSpots(px, py, tgx, tgy, Math.trunc(steps / 2 + num));   // Fluff=steps/2+strength
    let n8 = 0;                                             // 平台节奏计数（num8，num7=10）
    while (steps > 0) {
      steps--;
      if (!inW(Math.trunc(px), Math.trunc(py), n6 + 5)) break;
      const x0 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(w - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(px - num - 4.0 - hrn(6))));
      const x1 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(w - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(px + num + 4.0 + hrn(6))));
      const y0 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(h - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(py - num - 4.0)));
      const y1 = Math.max(n6, Math.min(h - n6 - 1, Math.trunc(py + num + 4.0 + hrn(6))));

      hb.upd(x0, y0, x1, y1);

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon;

	public int OverrideMaxLengthAllowed;

97:export function placePot(store: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, type: number, style: number): boolean {
export function placePot(store: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, type: number, style: number): boolean {
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      if (!store.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || store.flags[store.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return false;
    }
    if (!store.inBounds(x + dx, y + 1)) return false;
    const gi = store.idx(x + dx, y + 1);
    if (!store.flags[gi] || store.half[gi] || store.slope[gi] !== 0) return false;
    if (!vanGenSolidType(store.type[gi])) return false;
  }
  const variant = rng.int(0, 2) * 36;   // genRand.Next(3)*36（仅成功时消费）
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      store.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, type, dx * 18 + variant, (dy + 1) * 18 + style * 36);
      store.half[store.idx(x + dx, y + dy)] = 0;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/** oceanDepths（WorldGen.cs:10968）：y > oceanLevel 直接 false；海滩列才 true */
export function oceanDepthsAt(store: TileStore, gs: GenState, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const oceanLevel = (gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2 + 40;
  if (y > oceanLevel) return false;
  return x < gs.beachDistance || x > store.w - gs.beachDistance;
}

The shelf loop starts at num13 (the ACTIVE cell!) and runs to num15-1 (num15 = first active right). So shelf columns = num13..num15-1 = (active cell) + placed cells + ... wait num15: places x+1.. until active at num15 → num15 = first active right. Shelf range [num13, num15) = active-left + all placed (both directions) — NOT including the right active cell. Total columns = num15 - num13.

MY implementation: px ends at first active left ✓, qx at first active right ✓, m from px to qx-1 ✓ same. 148 columns total.

Alternatively x86 has MORE candidates or longer runs due to grid diffs. The decisive tool = grid diff. Let me run the SW_MATRIX comparison for the dungeon segment NOW to see how big the grid gap is. Check the matrix scripts.

- **IL 注入四坑（后人必读）**：①值类型实例方法必须 `call` 不能 `callvirt`（int32.ToString() 用 callvirt=JIT InvalidProgramException，pass 静默跳过=世界无腐化带）；②`InsertBefore` 逆序循环会**倒序**指令（要正序 foreach）；③`Concat` 重载要按参数型过滤（First() 拿到的是 Concat(object,object)）；④`box` 的类型必须 ImportReference（TypeDefinition 跨模块炸 Write）。稳妥写法=String.Format(string,object,object,object)+box+AppendAllText。
- **P32 事件序对拍**：JS 侧 CorruptionPass.place3x2 加 `__swP32` 探针钩（默认零开销），与注入 exe 的 Place3x2 调用序逐条对齐——前 292,751 条全同，首分叉=P32(2703,412)（JS 成坛 (2702,411)、原版失败）。
